verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is a framework and platform, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question here. The pack only shows client-side MCP support: agents can consume tools from external MCP servers via MCPToolset. There is no evidence of a first-party MCP server that external agents could connect to. The llms.txt file and the statement that LiveKit is 'built for coding agents' do not show that such a server exists.
